A.label: Option A
A.note: Holds the 5-week limit with 1 spare night. Mostly 2–3 night stops — a travel-heavy pace with little room for weather.

B.label: Option B
B.note: Adds Montréal and an extra night each at Thousand Islands, Halifax and Acadia. Puts the Maritimes and Acadia in Québec's Construction Holiday, so book early.
